Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
- Frenzy - The last sentence of Frenzy reads "This round has a press,
only usable to continue combat.". Who has control of this press? The
controller of the target, the controller of the Master Card, or
either/both?

- Free Sates Rant - Free States Rant has the following general rules
modification "In this referendum, titles are worth 1 less vote each
(even in the prisci sub-referendum)". Does this mean that the prisci
sub-referendum is essentially null unless an Oration/Gaze is used, or
that the sub-referendum is only worth 2 votes in the main referendum?

Morgan Vening

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>- Frenzy - The last sentence of Frenzy reads "This round has a press,
>only usable to continue combat.". Who has control of this press? The
>controller of the target, the controller of the Master Card, or
>either/both?

Seems like Frenzy provides an environmental press, much like Trap. So it's not
like anyone really has "control" over it.

>- Free Sates Rant - Free States Rant has the following general rules
>modification "In this referendum, titles are worth 1 less vote each
>(even in the prisci sub-referendum)". Does this mean that the prisci
>sub-referendum is essentially null unless an Oration/Gaze is used, or
>that the sub-referendum is only worth 2 votes in the main referendum?

This means that Prisci titles are worth one less vote (thus 0), not that the
Prisci sub-referendum is affected (the Prisci block is still worth 3 votes).
Note that only cards that explicitly mention the Prisci sub-ref can affect it,
so BO/Dread Gaze don't give you Prisci votes. When FSR is played, this
effectively means that the Prisci block is null *unless* Gratiano happens to be
in play.

Halcyan 2
